research_rationale:
Identity: Executive Order 12411 of March 29, 1983, Government Work Space Management Reforms (48 FR 13391, March 31, 1983), read in full from the official Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12411.txt. I checked the own-text boundary against the held original: the order begins with its heading and recital, has section 1 (the heads of all Federal Executive agencies shall do the eight things in paragraphs (a) through (h)) and section 2 (delegation to the Administrator of General Services), and ends at the White House signature line before Executive Order 12412 begins on the next page. The eleven machine clauses (recital, section 1 lead-in, paragraphs 1(a) to 1(h), and section 2) cover the whole text without gaps and are confirmed without correction. Ending search: the order has no sunset, duration or terminating condition. The held corpus was searched for the number and the title: no instrument amends, revokes or supersedes it. Executive Order 12512 (April 29, 1985), the later Federal real property order, revokes only Executive Order 12348 and does not name this order. The later-events:ofr_catalog search has zero hits for this order. Authority: the recital invokes the President's authority under the Constitution and laws, including section 486 of title 40, and the U.S. Code note in the packet brackets that reference as now 40 U.S.C. 121. The text of 40 U.S.C. 121 and of the 2002 restatement is not held in the repository, so this claim does not rest on that statute: the commands in section 1 are addressed by the President to the heads of Executive agencies, and the recital also rests them on the Constitution and the laws generally. This limit is disclosed and is not treated as an ending. Current predicate: the U.S. Code note under 40 U.S.C. 584 (release point 119-121, in the packet) prints the order as provided with the updated bracket and no ending; the eCFR point-in-time search for 2026-10-14 lists the order among the authorities in 41 CFR 102-85.5 (GSA real property pricing policy); Federal Register notice 2024-18334 (an agency system-of-records notice) cites it as authority for maintenance of a work space system in 2024; and notices 97-20650 and E8-439 describe its requirements. Bounded searches read against their coverage notes: current-law:usc (release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted 2026-10-10 through 2026-10-14 are not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR as of 2026-10-14 and GovInfo CFR bulk XML; one hit, 41 CFR 102-85.5) and later-events:ofr_catalog (zero hits).
